scope: Rules identify only the producer contexts stated below. Unmatched 64-hex fields remain unclassified and block the inventory. A class is not proof of any particular value's input bytes.

rules.producer_context: human-form record and revision references; validate each revision source before migration; the assessment owner uses the byte-identical tos_source_record_digest_v1 profile, and historical producer attribution requires verification
source record revision history references; the assessment owner uses the byte-identical tos_source_record_digest_v1 profile, and historical producer attribution requires verification
source command request in revision history
source snapshot revision before the form command
source snapshot revision before the record command
native text layer binding hashes exact prepared record file bytes; source_text_layer_entry.rs prepared_native_binding
source claim receipt object binding; the assessment owner uses the byte-identical tos_source_record_digest_v1 profile, and historical producer attribution requires verification
source claim receipt source file binding
source claim receipt evidence file binding
source claim contexts can hash canonical payloads; resolve exact producer before migration
exact selected text UTF-8 bytes in source-text-unit anchors
payload custody hash; exact producer and payload require owner verification
exact selected text bytes in the structural text spine; tos-compiler antonovsky_structural
exact selected text bytes in the structural text spine; tos-compiler antonovsky_structural
exact selected text bytes in the structural text spine; tos-compiler antonovsky_structural
exact context text bytes; tos-compiler research_concept_workbench_source
exact selected text bytes; antonovsky_structural technical_markup views
exact source or target anchor text bytes; constructor_library

unresolved: All other contexts, including source_sha256 outside the specified receipt bindings, record_sha256 outside text-layer bindings, payload_sha256, enclosing transaction identities, raw file and line hashes, dynamic map keys and external stores require producer-specific classification.
PostgreSQL, immutable runtime stores, archived verifiers, D1 and compressed artifacts are outside the tracked JSON/JSONL scan.

legacy_profile_owners.tos_corpus_snapshot_canonical_v1: tos-foundation Json canonical profile; tos-source-store manifest and publication; snapshot canonical bytes include LF
legacy_profile_owners.tos_source_record_digest_v1: tos-foundation Json canonical profile; tos-command source_command::record_digest, source forms, claims and journals; tos-validation assessment references; no LF
legacy_profile_owners.tos_source_command_input_v1: tos-foundation Json canonical profile; tos-command source_command request and configuration inputs; no LF

independent_serialization: emit_python_compact_json is an insertion-ordered wire emitter, not a canonical digest profile

producer_and_consumer_inventory.status: Owner-level navigation only; individual direct calls, wrappers, all producers, consumer bindings, and external stores still require reconciliation before migration.
